description: This Java interface defines a factory for creating Props objects for an Akka actor responsible for persisting 'things'. It includes a method that takes a ThingId and a DistributedPub to produce the Props needed to instantiate such an actor.

classes.name: ThingPersistenceActorPropsFactory
classes.description: A functional interface that provides a method to create Props for a thing-persistence-actor based on a ThingId and DistributedPub access.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns an Akka Props object for a thing-persistence-actor, given a ThingId and a DistributedPub for publishing events.
